description: THIS FILE RECORDS WHERE EACH PLATFORM INJECTS THE CUSTOM DICTIONARY, PER CLEANUP STYLE. M12 is DECIDED (Andi, 2026-09-10, docs/backlog.md 'DECIDED 2026-09-10 -- M12'): the dictionary is injected in every cleanup style, Chat included; Android's behaviour is canon. Story 7-8 wrote down the divergent state without changing prompt-assembly code on either platform; Story 7.6 then changed the desktop Chat arm and flipped the M12-DICT-SCOPE-CHAT vector, so all three styles now agree. The entries stay labelled current-state-record: they record what is true on the tree, and the Rust test asserts that label. If a later change moves a platform away from this state: change the code first, then update that entry's column and its platforms_agree flag. That does NOT require editing the Rust test -- the test derives platforms_agree from the two columns and asserts the desktop column against the real prompt, so it follows a correct change on its own and fails only on an incorrect one. Do not make a divergence disappear by editing this file alone. ASSERTION COVERAGE: the desktop/Rust column is machine-asserted against the real CleanupStyle::system_prompt in src-tauri/src/llm/mod.rs. The Android/Kotlin column is NOT machine-asserted -- KlarvoApi.buildSystemPrompt and appendPromptExtensions are both private and reachable only from inside the network-calling cleanup function, and AC4 forbids changing prompt-assembly code to open a seam. The Kotlin values below were verified by reading the source on 2026-09-10 (appendPromptExtensions re-read on 2026-09-16 for Story 7.6, which changed no Kotlin) and are a written record, not a test result.

PINS (desktop only): the Polished arm of CleanupStyle::system_prompt interpolates {dict_section}, so custom dictionary terms reach the model. Android's appendPromptExtensions appends the dictionary whenever the term list is non-blank, with no style branching. AGREED on this style -- both platforms inject. DOES NOT PIN: the wording of the dictionary sentence (the two platforms phrase it differently), its position relative to the custom-instruction and sandwich sections, or whether the model actually honours it.

PINS (desktop only): the Verbatim arm of CleanupStyle::system_prompt interpolates {dict_section}. Android appends the dictionary for this style too. AGREED on this style -- both platforms inject. DOES NOT PIN: wording, section order, or model behaviour. Note Verbatim is the product default cleanup style.

M12, DECIDED (Andi, 2026-09-10): Chat INCLUDES the dictionary. PINS (desktop only): the Chat arm of CleanupStyle::system_prompt interpolates {dict_section}, like the Polished and Verbatim arms. Story 7.6 added it; before that, Chat was the only arm that omitted it -- the divergence Story 7-8 recorded in this entry. Android's appendPromptExtensions takes no style parameter and is called unconditionally, so Android injects the dictionary in Chat style too; Android was the canon side and did not change. AGREED on this style -- both platforms inject. DOES NOT PIN: wording, section order, or model behaviour (no model is called).
